title: take_back: one queued entry withdrawn, with what goes with it
description: The answer of take_back (decision 0221, rules 15 and 16). taken_back lists the entry named first and then what went with it, each as queued listed it before; queued lists the entries left, renumbered, and as_of is the new token for the next take_back. A take back that is refused (as the whole call) is an error, and nothing is changed.
